clips.title: The story
paras: A Fey Dragon Scale is a shimmering woodland relic harvested from the elusive faerie dragons living around Stonetalon Peak. It is sought after by the Darkspear witch doctor Jin'Zil, who uses it as an exotic reagent in an alchemical brew mocking night elven nature magic.

Faerie dragons are mysterious, elusive creatures tied closely to the wild groves of Kalimdor, particularly the untouched forests around Stonetalon Peak. Their scales carry a natural magical luster reminiscent of the deep woods they guard. While revered by the night elves as harmless woodland spirits and allies, outsiders view them as an untamed source of rare magical ingredients.
